# modkit v0.9.1 - Table of Contents

A set of tool to work with Elixir modules files.

## Modules

- [Modkit](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Modkit.md)
- [Modkit.Mod](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Modkit.Mod.md)
- [Modkit.Mount](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Modkit.Mount.md)
- [Modkit.Mount.Point](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Modkit.Mount.Point.md)
- [Modkit.Support.Subapp](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Modkit.Support.Subapp.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix mod.new](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mod.New.md): Creates a new module in the current application, based on a template.
- [mix mod.relocate](https://modkit.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Mod.Relocate.md): Relocates modules in application according to the `:mount` option in `:modkit`
configuration defined in the project file (`mix.exs`).
